# Cesur Polat

> Cesur Polat is a full-stack developer in Sakarya, Türkiye, specializing in .NET, Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, APIs, and modern, scalable web apps.

Cesur Polat develops modern, scalable web applications using ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL Server, and related technologies.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://cesurpolat.dev/): Overview of Cesur Polat, technical expertise, experience, and featured projects.

## Featured Projects

- [MiBudsClient](https://cesurpolat.dev/projects/mibuds-client): Open-source Python and Flet desktop client for Redmi Buds 6 Play with battery monitoring, Bluetooth device management, and low-latency controls.
- [VectorMark](https://cesurpolat.dev/projects/vectormark): Local-first TypeScript bookmark manager using IndexedDB, local embeddings, HNSW indexing, and semantic vector search.
- [Termoware](https://cesurpolat.dev/projects/termoware): Cesur Polat's engineering contributions to an enterprise HVAC selection and quotation platform, including optimized calculation services and gRPC-based architecture work.
- [IPTV](https://cesurpolat.dev/projects/iptv): Android TV streaming application built with Angular, .NET Core, Capacitor, and Playwright.
